name: Clay Street Hill Railroad / Clay St cable
geom: Clay St & Kearny St; Clay St & Leavenworth St
note: Hallidie's first line: trial run 1873-08-02, regular service 1873-09-01 Kearny-Leavenworth. Sold 1888 to Ferries & Cliff House Ry; Clay St then carried the Sacramento-Clay line (1891-1942; eastbound on Clay after 1906, east end at the Ferry/Drumm St). Suspended 1906-04-18 to 1908-06-08. Last day 1942-02-15.

name: Clay Street Hill Railroad / Clay St cable
geom: Clay St & Leavenworth St; Clay St & Van Ness Ave
note: 1877 extension west to Van Ness Ave; Clay St shuttle (Powell-Van Ness) discontinued 1891-09-09 when the Sacramento-Clay line was created (turned off Clay at Larkin).

name: Sacramento-Clay line (post-1906 Clay St section)
geom: Clay St & Leavenworth St; Clay St & Fillmore St
note: After the 1906 fire the line was rebuilt with eastbound cars on Clay (from Fillmore) and westbound on Sacramento; restored 1908-06-08, last day 1942-02-15 (Market Street Railway).

name: Sacramento-Clay line (Sacramento St)
geom: Sacramento St & Drumm St; Sacramento St & Larkin St
note: Ferries & Cliff House Ry 'Sacramento line' from the Ferry via Sacramento St began 1888-09-19; Sacramento-Clay line from 1891-11-02; westbound track after 1906. Suspended 1906-1908; last day 1942-02-15. East end: Drumm St used as stand-in for the 19th-c. Ferry terminus (East St).

name: Sacramento-Clay line (Larkin-Fillmore)
geom: Sacramento St & Larkin St; Sacramento St & Fillmore St
note: Sacramento-Clay line opened 1891-11-02 (via Clay, Larkin, Sacramento to Walnut). Suspended 1906-1908; terminus cut back to Fillmore after 1906; last day 1942-02-15.

name: Sacramento-Clay line (Fillmore-Walnut)
geom: Sacramento St & Fillmore St; Sacramento St & Walnut St
note: West end at Walnut St car house; 'Sacramento-Clay west of Fillmore' not restored after 1906-04-18.

name: Sacramento-Clay line (Midwinter Fair extension)
geom: Sacramento St & Walnut St; Sacramento St & Arguello Blvd; Lake St & Arguello Blvd; Lake St & 6th Ave; 6th Ave & Fulton St
note: Extended 1894-02-19 from Walnut via Lake St and 6th Ave to D St (Fulton) for the Midwinter Fair; alternate cars cut back 1896; terminal again Walnut 1901-11-04 (CCM says closed west of Walnut in 1904). Link Sacramento-Lake via Arguello is an assumption.

name: Sutter Street Railroad (Sutter St)
geom: Sutter St & Market St; Sutter St & Larkin St
note: Converted from horsecars; cable service began 1877-01-27 (Market/Sansome to Larkin). Casebolt side grip. Merged into URR 1902; last full cable day 1906-04-17, then electrified.

name: Sutter Street Railroad (Sutter St west)
geom: Sutter St & Larkin St; Sutter St & Buchanan St; Sutter St & Presidio Ave
note: Extended Larkin-Buchanan 1879-06-14 and Buchanan-Central (Presidio) Ave 1879-10-10. Ended 1906-04-17 (electrified).

name: Sutter St Ry Larkin/Polk crosstown
geom: Larkin St & Sutter St; Larkin St & Market St
note: Larkin St line Sutter-Hayes (Market) converted from horsecar late 1878; rerouted 1883 via Polk, Post, Larkin. Ended 1906-04-17 (except Pacific Ave section).

name: Sutter St Ry Larkin/Polk crosstown (9th St)
geom: 9th St & Market St; 9th St & Mission St
note: 1883 extension across Market down 9th St to Mission (R.F. Morrow).

name: Sutter St Ry Larkin/Polk crosstown (9th St south)
geom: 9th St & Mission St; 9th St & Brannan St
note: 1887 extension down 9th St from Mission to Brannan.

name: Pacific Avenue cable line
geom: Polk St & Sutter St; Polk St & Pacific Ave
note: Crosstown line extended north from Sutter via Polk to Pacific Ave 1888-11-28; Polk section not restored after 1906 (assumed).

name: Pacific Avenue cable line
geom: Pacific Ave & Polk St; Pacific Ave & Fillmore St; Pacific Ave & Divisadero St
note: Pacific Ave Polk-Divisadero opened 1888-11-28 (CCM: Fillmore-Divisadero only in 1890-91 overhaul). Survived 1906; last day 1929-11-17 (Market Street Railway).

name: California Street Cable Railroad (lower)
geom: California St & Drumm St; California St & Kearny St
note: Extended east from Kearny to Market 1891-06-28. Survives as Muni line 61 (C). System-wide closures: 1906-04 to 1906-08-17, Cal Cable shutdown 1951-07-31 to 1952-01-13, 1956-12-30 to 1957-12-22 rebuild, 1982-09 to 1984-06-21 system rebuild.

name: California Street Cable Railroad
geom: California St & Kearny St; California St & Powell St; California St & Van Ness Ave
note: Opened 1878-04-10 Kearny-Fillmore (Leland Stanford). Oldest line still running. See seq 1 for closures.

name: California Street Cable Railroad (west)
geom: California St & Van Ness Ave; California St & Fillmore St
note: Part of the 1878 line; cut back to Van Ness Ave 1954-05-16.

name: California Street Cable Railroad (Presidio ext.)
geom: California St & Fillmore St; California St & Presidio Ave
note: Extended Fillmore-Central (Presidio) Ave 1879-05-05; abandoned 1954-05-16.

name: O'Farrell, Jones & Hyde line
geom: OFarrell St & Market St; OFarrell St & Jones St; Jones St & Pine St; Pine St & Hyde St; Hyde St & Washington St
note: Cal Cable crosstown line opened 1891-02-09 (last entirely new cable line in SF). Ceased 1954-05-16. Hyde St north of California kept as non-revenue/Powell-Hyde track.

name: O'Farrell, Jones & Hyde line (Hyde St north)
geom: Hyde St & Washington St; Hyde St & North Point St
note: Hyde St section to North Point; replaced by shuttle buses 1950-08-14 to 1951-01-29 during Broadway Tunnel construction; line ceased 1954-05-16 (reused by Powell-Hyde from 1957).

name: Jones Street Shuttle
geom: Jones St & Market St; Jones St & OFarrell St
note: Opened 1891-02-09 from Market/Jones/McAllister to O'Farrell; discontinued 1954-02-06.

name: Geary Street, Park & Ocean Railroad (cable)
geom: Geary St & Kearny St; Geary St & Van Ness Ave; Geary Blvd & Presidio Ave
note: Opened 1880-02-16 Kearny & Market to Central (Presidio) Ave; first cable line to resume after 1906 (1906-06-21); closed 1912-05-05 and rebuilt as Muni's first streetcar line.

name: Geary Street, Park & Ocean Railroad (steam dummy)
geom: Geary Blvd & Presidio Ave; Geary Blvd & Arguello Blvd; Arguello Blvd & Fulton St; Fulton St & 5th Ave
note: Steam 'motor' (dummy) street railway from Central Ave via Point Lobos Ave (Geary) and 1st Ave (Arguello) to 5th Ave & D St (Fulton). Replaced by cable 1892 (end year = 1892 cable extension).

name: Geary Street, Park & Ocean Railroad (1892 cable ext.)
geom: Geary Blvd & Presidio Ave; Geary Blvd & 5th Ave; 5th Ave & Fulton St
note: 1892-08-07: converted to standard gauge and cable extended via Geary and 5th Ave to D St (Fulton) (Rice chronology); Wikipedia says cable extended 'to 1st' — routing via 5th Ave per chronology. Closed 1912-05-05.

name: Geary Street, Park & Ocean Railroad (Fulton ext.)
geom: Fulton St & 5th Ave; Fulton St & 11th Ave
note: Extended from 5th Ave & D St to 11th Ave 1901-11-20 (Chutes amusement park). Closed 1912-05-05.

name: Presidio & Ferries Railroad (Union St)
geom: Columbus Ave & Montgomery St; Columbus Ave & Union St; Union St & Steiner St
note: Union St line: cable from Washington & Montgomery (Columbus) to Steiner & Union; opened Jan 1882 (Rice chronology, Wikipedia table) - Cable Car Museum says 1880-10-23. Horsecar from the Ferry; powerhouse on Russian Hill summit. Cable ended 1906-04-17, line electrified (Muni from 1913).

name: Presidio & Ferries Railroad (Presidio ext.)
geom: Union St & Steiner St; Union St & Baker St; Baker St & Greenwich St; Greenwich St & Lyon St
note: Sept 1892: cable extended out Union to Baker, Baker to Greenwich, Greenwich into the Presidio (terminus near Presidio Blvd; Lyon St used as end). Before 1892 a steam dummy ran west of Steiner (route not traced).

name: Market Street Cable Railway (Market St trunk)
geom: Market St & Steuart St; Market St & Valencia St
note: Opened 1883-08-21 from the Ferry. All five MSCR lines shared Market St to the Ferry; cars every 15 s at rush. Last full cable day 1906-04-17; electrified 1906 (see sc_market_trunk).

name: Market Street Cable Railway (Valencia line)
geom: Valencia St & Market St; Valencia St & Mission St
note: Valencia St line opened 1883-08-21 to Mission St (29th); car barn at Valencia & Mission. Ended 1906-04-17.

name: Market St Cable Ry Haight St line
geom: Haight St & Market St; Haight St & Stanyan St
note: Opened 1883-08-21 to Golden Gate Park (Stanyan). Cars painted red. Ended 1906-04-17.

name: Market St Cable Ry McAllister St line
geom: McAllister St & Market St; McAllister St & Stanyan St
note: Started Nov 1883 to Golden Gate Park (Stanyan); yellow cars. Ended 1906-04-17.

name: Market St Cable Ry McAllister line (Fulton ext.)
geom: Stanyan St & McAllister St; Stanyan St & Fulton St; Fulton St & 8th Ave
note: Extended 1892-03-09 from Stanyan via D St (Fulton) to between 7th and 8th Aves.

name: Market St Cable Ry McAllister line (Fulton ext. 2)
geom: Fulton St & 8th Ave; Fulton St & 11th Ave
note: Extended to 11th Ave 1901-11-20 (the Chutes).

name: Market St Cable Ry Hayes St line
geom: Hayes St & Market St; Hayes St & Stanyan St
note: Opened 1886-05-20 (CCM: 1886-05-26) to Golden Gate Park; green cars; own powerhouse near Hayes/Masonic. Ended 1906-04-17.

name: Market St Cable Ry Castro line
geom: Market St & Valencia St; Market St & Castro St; Castro St & 18th St
note: Opened 1888-02-27 (replacing the 1880s 'Market Street Extension' steam dummy). Market section electrified after 1906.

name: Market St Cable Ry Castro line (Castro St)
geom: Castro St & 18th St; Castro St & 26th St
note: 18th-26th restored 1907-08-29 as a feeder to the 8 streetcar; last day 1941-04-05 (replaced by 24 bus). Out of service 1906-04-18 to 1907-08-29.

name: Market St Cable Ry Castro line (Market-18th)
geom: Castro St & Market St; Castro St & 18th St
note: Castro St between Market and 18th: cable 1888-1906, not restored.

name: Powell-Mason line
geom: Powell St & Market St; Powell St & Jackson St; Jackson St & Mason St; Mason St & Columbus Ave; Columbus Ave & Taylor St; Taylor St & Bay St
note: Ferries & Cliff House Ry: Powell St Market-Jackson from 1888-03-28, Powell & Mason line to Bay & Taylor 1888-04-05; route never changed. Muni line 59. Closed 1906-04 to 1907-03-01 and 1982-09 to 1984-06-21. Inbound cars use Mason/Washington/Powell.

name: Powell-Jackson (Washington-Jackson) line, Jackson St
geom: Jackson St & Mason St; Jackson St & Hyde St; Jackson St & Steiner St
note: Opened 1888-04-05 (outbound on Jackson, inbound on Washington). Cut back to Steiner after 1906 (restored 1907-03-01). Last trip 1956-09-02. Jackson east of Hyde reused by Powell-Hyde from 1957-04-07.

name: Powell-Jackson line (west of Steiner)
geom: Jackson St & Steiner St; Jackson St & Presidio Ave; Presidio Ave & California St
note: Original west end at Central (Presidio) Ave & California; not restored after 1906 (steam/electric line to Cliff House continued west of here).

name: Powell-Jackson line (Washington St inbound)
geom: Washington St & Steiner St; Washington St & Hyde St; Washington St & Powell St
note: Inbound track. Washington St Hyde-Powell continued as Powell-Hyde inbound (see cc_powell_hyde).

name: Powell-Hyde line
geom: Jackson St & Mason St; Jackson St & Hyde St; Hyde St & Washington St; Hyde St & Beach St
note: Created 1957-04-07 by cutting the Washington-Jackson line back to Hyde St and grafting the Hyde St leg of the O'Farrell, Jones & Hyde line; new turntable at Hyde & Beach (Aquatic Park). Muni line 60. Shares Powell St with Powell-Mason.

name: Omnibus Cable Co. Post St line
geom: Post St & Market St; Post St & Leavenworth St; Leavenworth St & McAllister St; Polk St & Grove St; Polk St & Market St; 10th St & Market St; 10th St & Howard St
note: Opened 1889-08-26: Market via Post, Leavenworth, City Hall Ave, Grove, Polk, 10th St to Howard. City Hall Ave (vanished) approximated by Leavenworth/McAllister to Polk/Grove. Discontinued 1899-12-31.

name: Omnibus Cable Co. Howard St line
geom: Howard St & The Embarcadero; Howard St & 10th St
note: Opened 1889-08-26 from the Ferry via East St (Embarcadero) and Howard. Section Ferry-10th St (powerhouse) ran until 1899-12-31.

name: Omnibus Cable Co. Howard St line (Mission)
geom: Howard St & 10th St; Howard St & South Van Ness Ave; South Van Ness Ave & 24th St; South Van Ness Ave & 26th St
note: Howard & 26th St (Blue) line ran on Howard St (now South Van Ness Ave) to 26th; withdrawn 1893-08-05 (CCM: Howard St 10th-26th abandoned 1893).

name: Omnibus Cable Co. Howard & 24th St (Yellow) line
geom: 24th St & South Van Ness Ave; 24th St & Potrero Ave
note: 24th St branch to Potrero Ave. End year estimated: assumed abandoned with Howard St south of 10th in 1893 (CCM).

name: Omnibus Cable Co. Oak St line
geom: 10th St & Howard St; 10th St & Market St; Fell St & Market St; Fell St & Franklin St; Franklin St & Oak St; Oak St & Stanyan St; Stanyan St & Haight St
note: Opened 1889-11-02: Howard via 10th St, Fell, Franklin, Oak, Stanyan to Haight. Ended 1896-01-02 (converted to electric).

name: Omnibus Cable Co. Ellis St line
geom: Ellis St & Market St; Ellis St & Broderick St; Broderick St & Oak St; Oak St & Stanyan St
note: Opened 1889-11-02: Market via Ellis, Broderick, Oak, Stanyan to Haight (shares Oak/Stanyan with Oak St line). Discontinued 1895-11-11.

name: Market Street Railroad (first SF street railway)
geom: Market St & California St; Market St & Valencia St; Valencia St & 16th St
note: Opened 1860-07-04 from Market & California to Mission Dolores (16th & Valencia), first railway in SF; steam dummies 1860-1867, horses from 1867. Converted to cable 1883 (cc_market_valencia).

name: Market Street Extension (steam dummy)
geom: Market St & Valencia St; Market St & Castro St
note: Standard-gauge steam-dummy extension Valencia-Castro worked by two Baldwin 0-4-0T dummies built 1880, until 1888 (replaced by Castro cable). Start year = dummy build year (estimated).

name: Market St streetcar trunk (URR/Market St Ry + Muni)
geom: Market St & Steuart St; Market St & Valencia St; Market St & Castro St
note: Electrified after the 1906 quake (overhead permitted 1906-05-14). From c.1913-18 four tracks ('roar of the four'): Market St Ry inside, Muni outside; ex-MSR lines 5,6,7,8,21 converted to trolley buses by 1949-51. Muni J/K/L/M/N surface running ended 1982-09-19 (Muni Metro subway).

name: F Market & Wharves (heritage streetcar)
geom: 17th St & Castro St; Market St & Castro St; Market St & Steuart St
note: Heritage service: Historic Trolley Festival summers from 1983; full-time F Market from 1995 (to Transbay Terminal until 2000-03-03).

name: F Market & Wharves (Embarcadero extension)
geom: The Embarcadero & Market St; The Embarcadero & Bay St; The Embarcadero & Taylor St; Jefferson St & Taylor St; Jefferson St & Jones St
note: Extended along The Embarcadero to Fisherman's Wharf March 2000 (first trips 2000-03-04).

name: E Embarcadero (heritage streetcar)
geom: King St & 4th St; King St & 2nd St; The Embarcadero & King St; The Embarcadero & Market St
note: Trial runs 2008; weekend service 2015, daily from late April 2016; suspended 2020-03 (COVID) - check current status. North of Market shares F tracks.

name: Mission St streetcar (Market St Ry / Muni 14)
geom: Mission St & The Embarcadero; Mission St & 16th St; Mission St & Cesar Chavez St; Mission St & Ocean Ave
note: Market Street Railway electric line on Mission opened 1894-09-15 (replacing horsecars); streetcar service ended 1949-01-15 (buses, then trolley buses 1952). Extent in 1894 not verified beyond Ocean Ave.

name: Ocean Ave line (Market St Ry 12 / Muni K)
geom: Ocean Ave & Mission St; Ocean Ave & Frida Kahlo Way
note: Branch of the Mission St line along Ocean Ave built in six days, opened 1895-12-04 for the Ingleside racetrack; URR route 12 removed from Ocean Ave 1945-04-08.

name: Ocean Ave line (K Ingleside section)
geom: Ocean Ave & Frida Kahlo Way; Ocean Ave & Junipero Serra Blvd
note: URR route 12 from 1895 (to Victoria St, then Ingleside House); Muni K joint use from 1919 (Parkside Agreements), K only from 1945. K reached Balboa Park c.1979-80.

name: Muni Geary streetcar trunk (A/B/C)
geom: Geary St & Kearny St; Geary St & Van Ness Ave; Geary Blvd & Presidio Ave; Geary Blvd & Arguello Blvd; Geary Blvd & 10th Ave
note: Muni's first line: A Geary-10th Ave opened 1912-12-28 (Kearny & Market to 10th Ave & Fulton); later via Market St to the Ferry. Rail replaced by buses 1956-12-29 (38 Geary).

name: Muni Geary streetcar (B west of 10th Ave)
geom: Geary Blvd & 10th Ave; Geary Blvd & 33rd Ave
note: B Geary began as 10th-33rd Ave shuttle (1912), later through-routed Ferry-Ocean Beach (via 33rd Ave, Balboa, 45th Ave, Cabrillo - not traced; extension year not found). Ended 1956-12-29.

name: Muni A Geary-10th Ave (10th Ave)
geom: 10th Ave & Geary Blvd; 10th Ave & Fulton St
note: A line along 10th Ave to Fulton; discontinued 1932-12-05.

name: Muni D Geary-Van Ness
geom: Van Ness Ave & Geary St; Van Ness Ave & Union St
note: Created 1914-08-15 for the 1915 PPIE (Ferry-Market-Geary-Van Ness-Chestnut-Scott); replaced by buses 1950-03-18 (45 Greenwich).

name: Muni D Geary-Van Ness (Chestnut, 1914-18)
geom: Van Ness Ave & Union St; Van Ness Ave & Chestnut St; Chestnut St & Scott St
note: Original route via Chestnut to Scott; moved to Union St in 1918.

name: Muni D Geary-Van Ness (Union St, 1918-50)
geom: Union St & Van Ness Ave; Union St & Steiner St; Steiner St & Greenwich St; Greenwich St & Lyon St
note: 1918: via Union St, extended via Steiner and Greenwich into the Presidio; ended 1950-03-18.

name: Union St electric line (Presidio & Ferries, then Muni E)
geom: Washington St & The Embarcadero; Washington St & Columbus Ave; Columbus Ave & Union St; Union St & Larkin St; Larkin St & Vallejo St; Vallejo St & Franklin St; Franklin St & Union St; Union St & Baker St; Baker St & Greenwich St; Greenwich St & Lyon St
note: Presidio & Ferries converted its cable line to electric after 1906; city took it over Dec 1913 (Muni E Union, PPIE route). E routing: Embarcadero, Washington/Jackson, Columbus, Union, Larkin, Vallejo, Franklin, Union, Baker, Greenwich into the Presidio. Replaced 1947-07-20 by the R-Howard trolley bus (41 Union).

name: Muni F Stockton (incl. Stockton St Tunnel 1914)
geom: Stockton St & Market St; Stockton St & Sutter St; Stockton St & Columbus Ave; Columbus Ave & North Point St; North Point St & Van Ness Ave; Van Ness Ave & Chestnut St; Chestnut St & Laguna St
note: Market & Stockton via Stockton St (Stockton St Tunnel Sutter-Sacramento, opened 1914, built for these cars), Columbus, North Point, Van Ness, Chestnut to Laguna; PPIE line. Start year from tunnel opening (1914); replaced 1951-01-20 by 30 Stockton trolley bus.

name: Muni F Stockton (Chestnut ext.)
geom: Chestnut St & Laguna St; Chestnut St & Scott St
note: Extended Laguna-Scott 1916.

name: Muni F Stockton (4th St ext.)
geom: 4th St & Market St; 4th St & Townsend St
note: Extended 1947 down 4th St to the SP depot at Townsend.

name: Muni H Potrero / Van Ness
geom: Van Ness Ave & North Point St; Van Ness Ave & Market St; 11th St & Market St; 11th St & Division St; Potrero Ave & Division St; Potrero Ave & 25th St; Potrero Ave & Cesar Chavez St
note: Created 1914-08-15 for the PPIE: Army (Cesar Chavez) & Potrero via Potrero, Division, 11th, Van Ness to Fort Mason (North Point used as stand-in). Southern half 1914-09-17, through to Army St 1916-12-21 (Ocean Shore joint track). Northern end cut back 1948; final end year not found (estimated 1948-50).

name: J Church
geom: Church St & Market St; Church St & 18th St; Church St & 22nd St; Church St & 30th St
note: Opened 1917-08-11 (Church & 30th to Market & Van Ness; to the Ferry from 1918-06-01). Private right-of-way through Dolores Park 18th-22nd (path follows Church St here). Light rail from 1981 (Muni Metro, subway from 1981-06-17).

name: J Church extension to Balboa Park
note: Extension along the Bernal Cut (former SF&SJ right-of-way, San Jose Ave) to Balboa Park/Metro Center; opened 1991-08-31 for non-revenue moves, all-day J service from 1993-06-19. [geometry: OSM via Overture 2026-10-21 (Muni track); elevated from OSM bridge/tunnel tags]

name: Twin Peaks Tunnel
note: Opened 1918-02-03 with the K line (east portal at Market & Castro, inside the Market St subway since 1980; west portal West Portal Ave & Ulloa). 3.6 km. Eureka Valley station closed 1972. [geometry: OSM via Overture 2026-10-21 (Muni track)]

name: K Ingleside (surface)
geom: West Portal Ave & Ulloa St; West Portal Ave & Sloat Blvd; Junipero Serra Blvd & Sloat Blvd; Junipero Serra Blvd & Ocean Ave
note: K opened 1918-02-03 to St Francis Circle; extended via Junipero Serra Blvd and Ocean Ave to Miramar 1919-02-21, Brighton/Grafton 1919-05-18 (Ocean Ave section: see sc_ocean_ave). Light rail since 1980.

name: L Taraval
geom: West Portal Ave & Ulloa St; Ulloa St & 15th Ave; 15th Ave & Taraval St; Taraval St & 33rd Ave
note: Opened 1919-04-12 as West Portal-33rd Ave shuttle (on rebuilt URR Parkside trackage west of 20th Ave). Through to the Ferry from 1923-10-15. Light rail since 1980.

name: L Taraval (to 48th Ave)
geom: Taraval St & 33rd Ave; Taraval St & 46th Ave; Taraval St & 48th Ave
note: Tracks extended along Taraval to 48th Ave by 1923-01-14; 46th-48th now a 2-block storage spur.

name: L Taraval (Zoo extension)
geom: Taraval St & 46th Ave; 46th Ave & Vicente St; 46th Ave & Wawona St
note: Extended south on 46th Ave to the SF Zoo 1937-09-15.

name: M Ocean View (19th Ave right-of-way)
note: Opened 1925-10-06 as shuttle St Francis Circle-Broad & Plymouth; through to the Ferry 1927-10-31 to 1928-02-27; replaced by buses 1939-08-06. [geometry: OSM via Overture 2026-10-21 (Muni track); elevated from OSM bridge/tunnel tags]

name: M Ocean View (19th Ave right-of-way)
note: Streetcar service restored 1944-12-17; light rail from 1980-12-17. (Geometry = present OSM track, which was rebuilt 1993-95 at SF State/Stonestown.) [geometry: OSM via Overture 2026-10-21 (Muni track); elevated from OSM bridge/tunnel tags]

name: M Ocean View extension to Balboa Park
note: Extended 1980-08-30 from Broad & Plymouth to Balboa Park BART. [geometry: OSM via Overture 2026-10-21 (Muni track); elevated from OSM bridge/tunnel tags]

name: N Judah (Duboce Ave)
geom: Duboce Ave & Church St; Duboce Ave & Noe St
note: N Judah began 1928-10-21 with the Sunset Tunnel (last new Muni line until the T in 2007). Light rail from 1980-02-18.

name: N Judah (Carl - Judah)
geom: Carl St & Cole St; Carl St & Arguello Blvd; Irving St & Arguello Blvd; Irving St & 9th Ave; 9th Ave & Judah St; Judah St & La Playa St
note: Carl St, Irving St, 9th Ave, Judah St to Ocean Beach (La Playa loop). Raised right-of-way on Judah 9th-19th Aves.

name: Sunset (Duboce) Tunnel
note: 4,232 ft tunnel from Duboce & Noe to Carl & Cole, opened with the N Judah 1928-10-21. [geometry: OSM via Overture 2026-10-21 (Muni track)]

name: Market Street subway (Muni Metro level)
note: Upper (Muni) level of the two-level Market St subway, completed 1978; Muni Metro inaugurated 1980-02-18 (weekday N), K 1980-06-11, L/M 1980-12-17, J 1981-06-17; seven days a week from 1982-11-20. [geometry: OSM via Overture 2026-10-21 (Muni track)]

name: Muni Metro Extension (Embarcadero/King St)
note: Opened 1998-01-10 (E Embarcadero shuttle Jan-Aug 1998, then N Judah extended 1998-08-22). Portal at Embarcadero/Folsom; surface along The Embarcadero and King St to 4th & King. [geometry: OSM via Overture 2026-10-21 (Muni track); elevated from OSM bridge/tunnel tags]

name: T Third Street
note: Limited service from January 2007, full service 2007-04-07 (4th & King to Sunnydale via 3rd St/Bayshore Blvd). [geometry: OSM via Overture 2026-10-21 (Muni track); elevated from OSM bridge/tunnel tags]

name: Central Subway (T Third) (part 1/2: ground)
note: T rerouted through the Central Subway (4th & Brannan portal - Yerba Buena/Moscone - Union Square - Chinatown) 2023-01-07 (weekend service from 2022-11-19). [geometry: OSM via Overture 2026-10-21 (Muni track); elevated from OSM bridge/tunnel tags]

name: Central Subway (T Third) (part 2/2: tunnel)
note: T rerouted through the Central Subway (4th & Brannan portal - Yerba Buena/Moscone - Union Square - Chinatown) 2023-01-07 (weekend service from 2022-11-19). [geometry: OSM via Overture 2026-10-21 (Muni track); elevated from OSM bridge/tunnel tags]

name: 40 San Mateo interurban (SF section)
geom: 5th St & Market St; 5th St & Mission St; Mission St & 16th St; Mission St & Ocean Ave; Mission St & Onondaga Ave
note: San Francisco & San Mateo Electric Ry / URR: built out to San Mateo, service from 1902-12-31; northern terminus 5th & Market by 1906; ran down Mission to San Jose Ave and private right-of-way. Discontinued 1949 (track and cars worn out). SF section path simplified to Mission St.

name: 40 San Mateo interurban (Peninsula, approximate)
note: LOW CONFIDENCE: hand-placed along the documented corridor (Daly City - Colma - South SF - San Bruno - Millbrae - Burlingame - San Mateo, parallel to Mission Rd/El Camino Real; Centennial Way trail reuses part of the right-of-way). Trace from a 1910s USGS topo before use.

name: San Francisco & San Jose RR: Valencia St street running
geom: Valencia St & Market St; Valencia St & 25th St
